subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should permanent reply-session initialization conflict recovery be owned by shared session initialization, Discord ingress, or explicitly layered across both?
rationale: Two open PRs address the same conflict at different boundaries, and repository policy favors one canonical path unless owners intentionally approve non-overlapping layered recovery.

options.title: Shared session recovery
options.body: Use the shared self-heal as canonical and retain Discord-specific recovery only for a proven transport responsibility it does not cover.

options.title: Discord-only retry
options.body: Keep recovery in Discord and decline the shared owner-layer approach for this failure mode.

options.title: Layered recovery
options.body: Retain both with explicit retry budgets and tests proving bounded latency and exactly-once dispatch.

recommendation.title: Shared session recovery
recommendation.body: Use the shared self-heal as canonical and retain Discord-specific recovery only for a proven transport responsibility it does not cover.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history covers both the Discord dispatch path and the shared session lifecycle boundary needed for this decision.
